body:
Proposal: cli/cli#13816
Tracking issue: github/planning-tracking#3431

## What this does

Adds named field columns to `gh project item-list`:

```
gh project item-list <project-number> --owner <login> --field "Status"
```

- `--field <name>` (repeatable) resolves the field by name and adds a column showing each item's value for it, with no separate field-ID preflight lookup.
- `--field-id <id>` does the same by node ID. The two are mutually exclusive, and an unknown `--field-id` lists candidate fields as `name (id)` for symmetry with the name-based errors.
- Name matching is case-insensitive, mirroring the Projects v2 platform API.

## Relationship to cli/cli#13807

This builds on the same shared name-resolution layer as the `item-edit` PR cli/cli#13807. To keep the two PRs independently mergeable, each one adds its own copy of the small, self-contained field-resolver file `pkg/cmd/project/shared/queries/resolve_fields.go` (~90 lines: `ResolveFieldByName`, `ResolveFieldByID`, and their error types), with identical contents in both. Because the copies match exactly, Git merges them into a single file automatically, so the two PRs can land in either order without conflicts or duplicate-definition build errors. The item-list-only `FieldValueNodes.DisplayValue` helper lives in its own `field_display.go`, so this PR leaves `queries.go` untouched.

commits.messageBody:
Add --field (by name) and --field-id (by node ID) to gh project item-list
so a named field's value is shown as a column without a separate field-ID
preflight lookup. The two flags are mutually exclusive; an unknown
--field-id lists candidate fields as "name (id)" for symmetry with the
name-based errors. Name matching is case-insensitive, mirroring the
Projects v2 platform API.

Field-name/ID resolution reuses the shared resolvers in resolve_fields.go.
That file (and its test) are byte-identical to the copy shipped by the
item-edit PR (#13807) so the two changes merge cleanly in any order: Git
auto-merges an identical "added by both" file into a single copy. The
item-list-only FieldValueNodes.DisplayValue helper lives in its own
field_display.go, leaving queries.go untouched so it never conflicts.

Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>
commits.messageHeadline: Add named field columns to gh project item-list

commits.messageBody:
Drop the conflict enumeration from the --field and --field-id help
strings; the "(repeatable)" capability note is kept. Conflicts are
validated at runtime with a clear message.

Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

Trim "(repeatable)" from the --field and --field-id help and instead
demonstrate repeatability with a two-column example. Consolidate the
tiny field_display.go by moving DisplayValue next to FieldValueNodes.ID
in queries.go, and normalize carriage returns and newlines so multiline
field values stay within a single table cell.

Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>
Copilot-Session: ea543af9-2102-4a70-b011-652d2457ce07

Sort the candidate field IDs returned in FieldAmbiguousError so the
ambiguous-name error is deterministic, matching the other sorted error
paths in ResolveFieldByName/ResolveFieldByID.

Paginate the project field list when extra field columns are requested
for a project with more than one page of fields. The item query only
returns the first page of fields, so --field/--field-id resolution could
incorrectly fail for projects with over 100 fields. When extra columns
are requested and the field connection reports another page, fetch the
full field list via ProjectFields before resolving.

introduced via the item-edit PR. Both sides added
queries/resolve_fields.go and its test; keep this branch's version, which
additionally sorts the candidate field IDs in FieldAmbiguousError so the
ambiguous-name error is deterministic. This is a strict improvement over
trunk's copy and benefits item-edit, which shares the same file.

queries.go auto-merged cleanly: trunk's ProjectField.DataType() and this
branch's FieldValueNodes.DisplayValue()/singleLineFieldValue() helpers
occupy separate regions and coexist without duplication.

commits.messageBody:
JSON output ignores the selected table columns, so combining --format
with --field or --field-id is contradictory. Add a mutually exclusive
check that detects an explicit format via the populated exporter, with a
deterministic error message, and cover both conflicts in parsing tests.

## Pull request overview This PR extends `gh project item-list` to support rendering additional columns for ProjectV2 fields specified by name (`--field`) or node ID (`--field-id`), leveraging shared field-resolution helpers under `pkg/cmd/project/shared/queries`. **Changes:** - Added a self-contained field resolver (`ResolveFieldByName` / `ResolveFieldByID`) with actionable, candidate-carrying error types. - Added `FieldValueNodes.DisplayValue` (plus `singleLineFieldValue`) to render field values safely in a single-line table cell. - Updated `gh project item-list` to accept `--field/--field-id`, validate mutual exclusion, and render extra field columns; added unit tests for the new behavior.
